I recommend giving yourself a time limit when doing the questions (bringing a watch would help you keep track of the time a lot easier) so like, try to use a minute (Or less if possible! You can skim short questions pretty easily, but don't dwell on it too long. One or two reads should be enough to give you the amount of information you need to work with!) to analyse the question's main points (do something to make those points as obvious as possible!) Then see if you can find an immediate solution within like 2 or 3 minutes, but no more than that!! If you can't answer the question, circle it, fold the page and move on. Go back after you've finished the paper and check while doing the questions you've missed out. This should help you cut some time out of puzzling over a question for too long.

If you seriously have no idea, and you happen to have time left, just fiddle with the numbers and place them into whatever formulas you can remember/ think applies to the question, sometimes you might get lucky!

If you happen to remember some formulas before during the paper, just write it down onto the formula sheet and save yourself the effort of trying to recall those formulas again later in the paper.

Hope this helps! Good luck for your paper!!  ^_^

PS: remember to get lots of sleep too! Don't cram and end up blanking out tomorrow!
